results.name: Ordnode.Valid
results.source_text:
/-- The validity predicate for an `Ordnode` subtree. This asserts that the `size` fields are
correct, the tree is balanced, and the elements of the tree are organized according to the
ordering. -/
def Valid (t : Ordnode α) : Prop :=
  Valid' ⊥ t ⊤
results.docstring:
The validity predicate for an `Ordnode` subtree. This asserts that the `size` fields are

results.name: Ordnode.Valid'
results.source_text:
/-- The validity predicate for an `Ordnode` subtree. This asserts that the `size` fields are
correct, the tree is balanced, and the elements of the tree are organized according to the
ordering. This version of `Valid` also puts all elements in the tree in the interval `(lo, hi)`. -/
structure Valid' (lo : WithBot α) (t : Ordnode α) (hi : WithTop α) : Prop where
  ord : t.Bounded lo hi
  sz : t.Sized
  bal : t.Balanced
results.docstring:

results.name: SummationFilter.conditional
results.source_text:
/-- **Conditional summation**, for ordered types `β` such that closed intervals `[x, y]` are
finite: this corresponds to limits of finite sums over larger and larger intervals. -/
@[simps] def conditional : SummationFilter β where
  filter := (atBot ×ˢ atTop).map (fun p ↦ Finset.Icc p.1 p.2)

results.name: FTheory.SU5.ChargeSpectrum.viableCompletions
results.docstring:
The multiset of charges which are completions of charges which minimally allow the top Yukawa,
which are not phenomenologically constrained, and do not regenerate dangerous couplings.

This can be constructed via

`#eval completeMinSubset same.allowedBarFiveCharges same.allowedTenCharges`

results.name: FTheory.SU5.ChargeSpectrum.viableCompletions_card
results.source_text:
lemma viableCompletions_card (I : CodimensionOneConfig) :
    (viableCompletions I).card = if I = same then 70 else
      if I = nearestNeighbor then 48 else 37 := by
  cases I <;> rfl

results.docstring:

results.name: FTheory.SU5.ChargeSpectrum.viableCompletions_disjiont_viableChargesAdditional
results.source_text:
lemma viableCompletions_disjiont_viableChargesAdditional (I : CodimensionOneConfig) :
    Disjoint (viableCompletions I) (viableChargesAdditional I) := by
  refine Multiset.inter_eq_zero_iff_disjoint.mp ?_
  cases I
  <;> decide +kernel

results.name: FTheory.SU5.ChargeSpectrum.viableCompletions_subset_viableCharges
results.source_text:
lemma viableCompletions_subset_viableCharges (I : CodimensionOneConfig) :
    ∀ x ∈ (viableCompletions I), x ∈ viableCharges I := by
  intro x hx
  rw [viableCharges, Multiset.mem_add]
  exact Or.inl hx

results.name: Finset.exists_disjoint_union_of_even_card
results.source_text:
theorem Finset.exists_disjoint_union_of_even_card [DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} (he : Even #s) :
    ∃ (t u : Finset α), t ∪ u = s ∧ Disjoint t u ∧ #t = #u :=
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := he
  let ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (show n ≤ #s by lia)
  ⟨t, s \ t, by simp [card_sdiff_of_subset, disjoint_sdiff, *]⟩

results.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_union_disjoint
results.source_text:
lemma ofFinset_union_disjoint (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a b : Finset (Fin φs.length))
    (h : Disjoint a b) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a * ofFinset q φs.get b = ofFinset q φs.get (a ∪ b) := by
  rw [ofFinset_union, Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h]
  simp

results.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_union
results.source_text:
lemma ofFinset_union (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a b : Finset (Fin φs.length)) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a * ofFinset q φs.get b = ofFinset q φs.get ((a ∪ b) \ (a ∩ b)) := by
  rw [ofFinset_eq_prod, ofFinset_eq_prod, ofFinset_eq_prod]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  congr
  funext x
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_self, one_mul, mul_one,
    Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, not_and]
  split
  · rename_i h
    simp [h]
  · rename_i h
    simp [h]

results.name: Equiv.sumEquivSigmalCond
results.source_text:
/-- An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`. -/
def sumEquivSigmalCond : Fin m ⊕ Fin n ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) :=
  calc Fin m ⊕ Fin n
    _ ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin m := sumComm ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, bif b then (Fin m) else (Fin n) := sumEquivSigmaBool ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) := sigmaCongrRight (fun | true | false => Equiv.refl _)
results.docstring: An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`.

results.name: Finset.card_univ_sdiff
results.source_text:
theorem Finset.card_univ_sdiff [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] (s : Finset α) :
    #(univ \ s) = Fintype.card α - #s := by grind

results.name: Finset.card_sub_card_eq
results.source_text:
lemma card_sub_card_eq (s t : Finset α) : #t - #s = #(t \ s) - #(s \ t) :=
  calc
    #t - #s = #t - #(s ∩ t) - #(s \ t) := by grind
    _ = #(t \ (s ∩ t)) - #(s \ t) := by grind
    _ = #(t \ s) - #(s \ t) := by grind
